rationale_overall: At cap=2 the bar for a swap is a dated breach/peak on an incumbent plus a specific alternative in buildup with commercial evidence. Neither holds: NVDA delivered a Feb 21 Q4 FY24 print (revenue $22.1B +265% YoY; data-center $18.4B +409% YoY) and unveiled Blackwell/GB200 at GTC Mar 18, both mid-surge not peak; MSFT's Jan 30 FQ2 showed Azure accelerating (Intelligent Cloud $25.9B +20%) with AI monetization ramping, no breach. Pass-1 across every next-wave surfaced only diffuse non-dated-catalyst chatter this quarter, nothing strong enough to displace either incumbent at a 2-slot cap. Hold MSFT/NVDA.
